acceptance: Capability manifest binds each browser/local worker to its observed origin and effective user principal.

positive.fixture: Rust validates the manifest; binding ties client, origin, document, principal, runtime and manifest digest; renew and end

negative.fixture: static dev token cannot own a session, skewed or malformed manifest, second principal, binding cap, revoked client ends bindings

versions.primitive: no primitive change; wasm ABI 4, protocol vsf-ext-v1, pairing and session endpoints v1

security_and_source_permissions: One principal per client; skew 5 min; TTL 15 min; max age 8 h; max 8 bindings.
known_limitations: The principal is a per-installation pseudonym, not an account identity
